name: skills-panel
description: Switch Claude's skills on and off with simple switches, for one project or just one chat. Profiles, focus, history and undo. Never edits your skill files.

trackUsage.title: Count skill usage
trackUsage.description: Count how often each skill is used in each folder, so the panel can show "used 5×" and list unused skills. The counts stay on this computer.

unusedDays.title: Days until a skill counts as unused
unusedDays.description: A skill that is on in a folder but was not used there for this many days is listed under Unused.
